method_notes.tables_read_written: Derived deterministically: page -> trpc procedures called in page file -> procedure body in router -> direct Drizzle table refs (.from/.insert/.update/.delete/joins/db.query.*) plus transitive resolution through server/db.ts helper functions (fixpoint). Component-level tRPC calls outside the page file are NOT included.
method_notes.used_by_pages: Literal grep for direct imports of the table from drizzle/schema in client/src/pages files, per spec.
method_notes.used_by_trpc_routers: Literal word-boundary grep for the table variable name across server/routers/**/*.ts plus server/routers.ts and server/_core/systemRouter.ts, per spec (test files included).
method_notes.stripe_touched: True if the page file has actual Stripe code integration (stripe package import, loadStripe/Stripe() call, or checkout/billing/js.stripe.com URL) or any tRPC procedure it calls (incl. resolved db.ts helpers) references Stripe. Prose-only mentions (e.g. legal pages) do not count.
